projects.title: Dust Walkers
projects.description: I joined the Dust Walkers team as a Gameplay Programmer in late 2024. I started out working on the movement system and added a dodge roll mechanic. After becoming familiar with the codebase, I moved around to other areas as needed, including performance optimization, enemy behaviours, and bug fixes. I also took ownership of the key remapping system and associated UI.

projects.title: West Coast Summit Supply
projects.description: West Coast Summit Supply is a fictional outdoor gear store that we brought to life through a custom-built e-commerce website. Designed with WordPress and WooCommerce, this project served as my group capstone for the BCIT FWD program. I was responsible for the scaling between desktop and mobile views, creating a custom mobile dropdown menu using JavaScript, and setting up a store finder using the Google Maps API.
key_features: Custom WP Hooks & Templates - Enhanced functionality with templates and custom WordPress hooks
Custom JavaScript - Improved interactivity and dynamic elements for a smooth user experience
Google Maps Store Finder - Integrated a store locator using the Google Maps API
